scope: Pinned SDK/native counter discovery, portable evidence and proposed separate Read completion proof; no whole-change acceptance
reviewer: root adversarial pass; no delegated agents

materialFindingsResolved.finding: The discovery assumed a max-turn result would be followed by a clean iterator.
materialFindingsResolved.resolution: R1 is preserved as failed; both CLI versions independently expose exit code one after the max-turn result. R3 records the error, binds it exactly to the preceding native result using the public SDK behavior, and requires physical process/stdio joins. Unrelated iterator errors fail. No E72 predicate changed.

materialFindingsResolved.finding: The second discovery assumed the iterator error would retain the plain native process-exit message.
materialFindingsResolved.resolution: R2 is preserved as failed. The public SDK replaces that exception with prior result error text. R3 compares privately and emits only a binding boolean; actual exit code and signal witnesses stay independent.

materialFindingsResolved.finding: A proposed Read completion test based on substring output labels would also pass on the launch prompt or an incomplete output file.
materialFindingsResolved.resolution: The design now requires an unambiguous final assistant report parsed from the actual public Read response and bound to the child's observed HTTP end-turn response, with role/record order and independent Bash receipts. Prompt-only, quoted and foreign-report negative controls are explicit. Implementation and native acceptance remain held.

limitations: Only SDK 0.2.141 with CLI 2.1.284 and 2.1.295 on Linux/x64 is qualified; no universal num_turns contract is inferred.
The installed arm uses installed SDK/CLI with the source query-options builder; it is not installed Meridian proxy acceptance.
Scripted API controls are not actual Claude Code/model/background product proof.
Read output-file syntax and public response record structure require actual-client observation and parser controls before acceptance.
Original TaskOutput and historical 9256 ms wait failures remain preserved; no lease cause or fix is inferred.
Read scenario implementation, local code gates after that change, baseline/source/installed live proof and final-head CI remain required.
All inherited mixed-auto, cancellation, caption, reporter/platform/gateway and broader package holds remain.
